review_candidates.title: Social media- en contentspecialist
review_candidates.description: Ondernemingsverenigingen VNO-NCW en MKB-Nederland staan voor een samenleving met gelijke kansen en werk voor iedereen. De divisie Communicatie speelt een centrale rol binnen de werkorganisatie. Zo zijn we elke dag in staat onze opdracht richting onze leden, stakeholders, besturen en voorzitters optimaal te vervullen. Wil jij werken aan content die gezien en gedeeld wordt door beleidsmakers, ondernemers, onze leden en de media? Wil je bijdragen aan de profilering van onze voorzitters en invloed hebben op het maatschappelijke en politieke debat over ondernemerschap, economie en samenleving? Dan is dit jouw baan. Wie wij zijn VNO-NCW en MKB-Nederland maken zich hard voor een excellent ondernemings- en vestigingsklimaat in Nederland. Dat doen we zowel op nationaal als internationaal niveau. Wij vertegenwoordigen ondernemingen van uiteenlopende grootte en verspreid over alle sectoren, zoals beursgenoteerde bedrijven, familiebedrijven, het midden- en kleinbedrijf en jonge ondernemingen. In samenwerking met overheden en andere maatschappelijke partijen streven we bij VNO-NCW en MKB-Nederland naar een inclusief en duurzaam Nederland, waar iedereen profiteert van toenemende welvaart. Daar is duurzame economische groei voor nodig en een goed ondernemingsklimaat om dat mogelijk te maken. Waarom deze functie zo tof is Als social media- en contentspecialist werk je aan de zichtbaarheid en profilering van onze voorzitters en organisatie. Je weet wat verschillende doelgroepen bezighoudt en begrijpt hoe je een boodschap op een aansprekende en geloofwaardige manier overbrengt. Je denkt mee over de juiste boodschap, het juiste moment, het juiste kanaal en de juiste vorm. Je bedenkt formats en vertaalt actuele thema’s, standpunten, speeches, bijeenkomsten en werkbezoeken naar content die werkt. Daarbij maak je niet alleen plannen, maar steek je ook zelf de handen uit de mouwen: je schrijft, filmt, fotografeert en monteert. Je werk wordt gezien door ondernemers, brancheverenigingen, beleidsmakers, politici, journalisten en andere stakeholders die invloed hebben op het maatschappelijke en politieke debat. Je werkt daarom zorgvuldig en hebt gevoel voor actualiteit, timing en bestuurlijke verhoudingen. Je maakt deel uit van het team Contentstrategie en werkt nauw samen met communicatieadviseurs, woordvoerders, beleidscollega’s, het social team en collega’s uit andere divisies. Ook heb je regelmatig contact met de voorzitters en externe partijen. Samen zorgen jullie voor een herkenbare, actuele en professionele profilering van VNO-NCW en MKB-Nederland. Wat jij doet Je bent een creatieve contentprofessional die strategie, advies en uitvoering goed met elkaar weet te verbinden. Je denkt vanuit de doelgroep en het doel van de communicatie, maar weet ook hoe je een idee vertaalt naar concrete content. Je: adviseert over de zichtbaarheid en profilering van onze voorzitters; bedenkt en ontwikkelt creatieve formats voor verschillende doelgroepen en kanalen; vertaalt actuele ontwikkelingen, standpunten, speeches, bijeenkomsten en werkbezoeken naar relevante content; schrijft en redigeert teksten voor onder andere LinkedIn, websites en andere communicatiekanalen; maakt en bewerkt foto- en videocontent; filmt en monteert zelfstandig korte video’s voor social media; bewaakt de kwaliteit, samenhang en herkenbaarheid van onze content; signaleert kansen in de actualiteit en komt proactief met ideeën; werkt samen met communicatieadviseurs, woordvoerders, beleidscollega’s en externe partijen; volgt ontwikkelingen op het gebied van social media, contentformats en visuele communicatie. Wie jij bent Je hebt vier tot zes jaar relevante werkervaring in social media, content, communicatie, journalistiek of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en beschikt over een goed gevoel voor taal, beeld en timing. Je begrijpt wat verschillende doelgroepen nodig hebben en kunt complexe of inhoudelijke onderwerpen vertalen naar heldere en aantrekkelijke content. Je bent gewend om te adviseren, maar vindt het ook leuk om zelf te creëren en te produceren. Je kunt goed filmen, fotograferen en monteren en hebt ervaring met relevante programma’s en tools. Je bent nieuwsgierig, creatief en omgevingsbewust. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking op. Omdat je dicht op de voorzitters en actuele politieke en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen werkt, ben je zorgvuldig, flexibel en bestuurlijk sensitief. Wat je van ons krijgt Bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.743,- en €4.679,- o.b.v. 37,5 uur, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. 28 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband) + 2 brugdagen. Eindejaarsuitkering. Vitaliteitsbudget en een internetvergoeding (samen €110,- netto) Thuiswerkvergoeding + een budget om je thuiswerkplek in te richten. Gratis gebruik van een inpandige gym. Mogelijkheid om hybride te werken. NS-Business Card (ook privé te gebruiken). Uitstekende pensioenregeling. Informele en ambitieuze werksfeer in een sociaal team. Veel ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. De kans om vanaf dag één mee te werken aan maatschappelijke en politieke vraagstukken die Nederland raken. Je stapt in een hecht, professioneel contentteam met humor en ambitie – in een organisatie die er midden in de samenleving écht toe doet. Solliciteren? Laat, voor 23 oktober , jouw cv achter in het sollicitatieformulier en voeg een link naar je portfolio toe. Heb je geen portfolio? Deel dan een voorbeeld van een tof project waaraan je hebt gewerkt. Bellen of appen kan via (+31) 6 3416 1894. We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten. Sluitingsdatum vacature: 23 oktober 2026 Lees voordat je solliciteert hoe wij omgaan met jouw persoonsgegevens in onze privacyverklaring voor sollicitanten.

review_candidates.description: Job Title: Project Controls Director Reporting to: Director of Programme and Risk Location: This position will be based in the Project Office in Bristol for a minimum of three (3) days per week, with travel to lender, sponsor and adviser locations as required.   About Simply Blue Energy: Founded in 2011 under the brand Simply Blue Group in, Simply Blue Energy (SBE) was formally established in 2025 to recognise Kansai Electric Power Co., Inc.’s (“KEPCO”) Share Subscription Agreement with Simply Blue Energy (OSW) Ltd, the offshore wind division of Simply Blue Group. Simply Blue Energy is an ambitious, values-driven company at the forefront of the global blue economy and is actively developing a significant offshore wind portfolio comprising of 8 GW of floating offshore wind and 4 GW of fixed-bottom wind projects across multiple markets. Our offshore wind portfolio includes Erebus, a 100MW test and demonstration project, which was awarded a Contract for Difference (CfD) in 2026, and the Salamander project in Scotland. The portfolio also comprises Emerald, Western Star and Aird Mhòr na Mara in Ireland, as well as projects in Spain and Portugal developed under the IberBlue Wind platform. To find out more about us, please visit www.simplyblueenergy.com About Erebus by Blue Gem Wind: Erebus is a world leading 100 MW test and demonstration floating offshore wind project located off the coast of Pembroke and is being developed by Simply Blue Energy’s Blue Gem Wind project company. Erebus was awarded a CfD in Allocation Round 7 and as a fully consented project now enters late-stage development, targeting a COD in 2030. The project is progressing through project finance structuring towards Financial Close. Purpose of the role:  The Project Controls Director is responsible for supporting Simply Blue Energy’s portfolio of offshore wind projects through the effective management of project controls discipline – cost, schedule, change, risk and reporting. The role resides within the Project Excellence Services (PES) function. In accordance with SBE portfolio needs and priorities, the Project Controls Director may be seconded to a project. This position will be seconded to the Erebus project, to work as part of the project leadership team, to support bringing the project to Financial Close in 2028. The Erebus project requires a highly experienced Project Controls candidate with a track record of late-stage development of offshore wind. Reporting to the Project Managing Director and working as part of the project leadership team, the Erebus Project Controls Director will own the project controls discipline including cost, schedule, change and reporting; and be able to say, with confidence, exactly where the project stands against budget and programme at any point on the road to FID.   Key Responsibilities: Supporting the Project to Financial Close Own the project controls workstream (cost, schedule, change and risk reporting) and ensure it delivers the information project leadership and sponsors need to reach a robust, well-evidenced Final Investment Decision. Maintain overall responsibility for project cost and schedule status, coordinating inputs from engineering, procurement, commercial and finance teams into one consistent, defensible picture. Track and report on the FID critical path and decision calendar, proactively flagging risks, dependencies and cost or schedule pressures that could delay Financial Close. Support the Commercial and Procurement Director and Business Case Manager with robust cost and schedule inputs into the investment case, financial model and board papers. Cost Control Manage project budget and cost control strategy, including DEVEX variation and change management. Lead all aspects of project cost control: budget setting, cost breakdown structures, commitments, accruals, forecasting, variance analysis and change control. Own the project cost baseline and ensure disciplined change management, with every contract variation, scope change and claim properly evaluated and reflected in the forecast. Provide early warning of cost overruns or emerging risks to budget, with clear mitigation recommendations, ahead of them becoming board-level issues. Work closely with the Financial Advisor and finance team to ensure cost data feeds cleanly into the project financial model and sensitivity analysis. Planning & Schedule Control Maintain and continuously assure the integrated project schedule, ensuring PMO, Commercial, HSE, Consenting, Stakeholder and Technical workstreams are properly sequenced and interdependencies are visible. Run regular schedule risk analysis and scenario planning, particularly around contracting strategy and long-lead procurement decisions.   Team Management & Leadership Build, lead and develop the project controls team, setting clear standards, ways of working and reporting cadence across cost and planning functions. Manage the performance, workload and development of direct reports, and act as a credible, visible leader across a matrixed, multi-disciplinary project team. Manage relationships with third-party cost and planning consultants, ensuring their outputs meet the standard required for lender and board scrutiny.   Governance & Reporting (including Risk and Change Management) Produce regular, board-ready cost and schedule status reporting for project leadership, the Blue Gem board, sponsor representatives and lenders. Maintain the project controls risk register in line with the wider Erebus commercial and procurement risk register. Oversee risk and change management and ensure the risk and change management registers are current and applied. Ensure project controls activity complies with sponsor SBE governance and approval requirements.   Core responsibilities include financial controls, change management, programme management, document control and IT support, with especial emphasis on cost control and risk management in the short term.  Experience and Qualifications: Required: Relevant degree in engineering, quantity surveying, project management, or a related discipline with at least 10 years’ relevant experience At least 6 years’ experience in the offshore wind sector with PMO leadership experience Demonstrable experience leading project controls (cost and/or planning) on at least one major project, ideally through to Final Investment Decision, in offshore wind, renewables or large-scale infrastructure Strong, hands-on cost control experience — budgeting, forecasting, variance and change management on complex, multi-contractor capital projects Proven experience building and managing a project controls team, including direct line management responsibility. Strong working knowledge of planning and scheduling tools and integrated project schedules for large capital projects. Ability to communicate cost and schedule status clearly and credibly to senior stakeholders, including boards, sponsors and lenders. Experience of offshore wind project development in the UK Excellent organisation skills with the ability to manage own workload, meet timescales and coordinate a number of external and internal stakeholders Excellent communication skills, with the ability to enable effective discussion and transfer of information between contractors, team members and other stakeholders Fluent in English (written and spoken) The technical skills to understand complex offshore operations and the ability to exchange with and understand subject experts Ability to work as a member of a large, multidisciplinary and international team Ability to use Microsoft Office and project management software e.g. Primavera P6, Sarfan Ability to create and communicate complex technical information clearly.   Your application: Applications for this role will close on 26 October 2026. Please note that applications received after this date will not be considered. We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if a sufficient number of suitable applications are received; however, the vacancy will remain open for a minimum of five days.

review_candidates.title: Planning Manager – Super High-Rise Towers (G+60+)
review_candidates.description: We are Azizi Developments, a leading Dubai-based developer and a passionate team driven by the goal of crafting exceptional homes and destinations for people living in the UAE. Our portfolio spans Dubai’s prime residential, hospitality, and commercial developments, reflecting our commitment to transparency, customer centricity, quality, integrity, and value creation through a construction-driven approach. Our portfolio includes some of Dubai's most exciting launches: Burj Azizi, set to be the world's second-tallest tower; Monaco Mansions; and Azizi Venice, a luxury waterfront community inspired by Venice. It also extends to Sharjah with Azizi Florence. As a Planning Manager, you will lead planning and scheduling for our high-rise and super high-rise tower construction projects. The role covers the full planning cycle, from baseline programme development to progress monitoring, delay analysis and recovery planning. The Planning Manager will make sure projects are delivered on time and in line with contractual milestones. The role works closely with project management, site teams, consultants, subcontractors and the client. Responsibilities: Develop, review and maintain the master baseline programme for high-rise and super high-rise tower projects (G+50 and above) in Primavera P6. Prepare detailed Level 1 to Level 5 schedules covering design, procurement, construction, MEP, façade, testing & commissioning and handover. Define the critical path, key milestones and interface points between disciplines and subcontractors. Plan vertical construction sequencing for super high-rise structures, including core walls, slab cycles, jump/climbing formwork, tower cranes, high-speed hoists and high-pressure concrete pumping strategy. Plan for super high-rise challenges such as outrigger and belt truss installation, mega columns, refuge floors, vertical logistics and wind-related work restrictions at height. Track actual progress against the baseline and produce weekly and monthly progress reports, S-curves, look-ahead programmes and dashboards. Monitor productivity, manpower and resource histograms, and flag deviations early. Carry out delay analysis (Time Impact Analysis, Windows Analysis, As-Planned vs As-Built) and prepare Extension of Time (EOT) submissions. Support the commercial team on variations, claims and contractual time-related matters under FIDIC and local contract conditions. Coordinate with design, procurement, construction, MEP and commercial teams to align the programme with long-lead items and approvals. Review and approve subcontractor programmes and make sure they integrate with the master schedule. Integrate cost and schedule data for earned value analysis (EVM), cash flow forecasting and resource-loaded programmes. Identify schedule risks and develop mitigation plans. Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering Proven experience in super high-rise tower construction projects in the GCC, with a minimum of G+60 floors 15+ years of experience in construction planning, including at least 5 years in a senior planning or Planning Manager role. Super high-rise tower experience (300m+) is a strong advantage. Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6, plus MS Project, MS Excel and reporting tools (Power BI is an advantage). Strong command of delay analysis methods, EOT preparation and FIDIC contract conditions. Solid understanding of super high-rise construction methods, structural cycles, MEP and façade sequencing, and vertical logistics planning. Experience with Dubai authority approvals and local project environments is an advantage. PMP or PMI-SP certification is a strong advantage.
